what_changed: No print: META's Q3 was in the base round. The trigger is the 2026-10-26 equity raise. Final terms (pricing term sheet, FWP dated 10-26): the Class A forward offering was upsized from $22.5B to $25.0B, 40,000,000 shares at $625.00 (initial forward price $622.91875, ~$24.9B net, settlement on or before 2027-11-19); 6,000,000-share option open and not exercised as of the filings to 10-27. Series A mandatory convertible preferred: 250M depositary shares at $50 = $12.5B, 6.50% dividend, conversion 1.3620-1.6000 Class A shares per $1,000 preferred (initial price $625.00, threshold appreciation price $734.2144), mandatory conversion ~2029-08-15, 1.875M-preferred over-allotment not exercised. In the set: forward shares and cash both counted at the horizon (shares.horizon 2,613M; pro forma net debt -$35,551M incl. -$12.5B preferred cash and +$645.5M preferred dividends paid before the horizon); preferred deducted as balance.preferred $12,662.5M with EPS to common net of $812.5M dividends; conversion shares not added (same claim inside the band); net interest in core EPS 2,300/5,000 -> 633/3,373. Operating drivers, multiples and scripted XBRL rows unchanged; no proceeds-funded growth credited (general corporate purposes). Research target (12m) 659.48 -> 656.07 (-0.5%); at 21x the raise costs -0.5% (vs the 2026-10-22 memory scenario of ~-2.2% for $50B replacing debt at a 3% discount: smaller raise, priced 0.9% below the last sale, and here it adds cash rather than retiring debt). Not modelled: the planned ~$60B ATM (no agreement; ~-0.6% if sold at ~$625) and the option exercises (~-0.1%).
